[Work overview](/d/ghostship-autonomous-work) · [Host](/d/ghostship-host) · [Security](/d/ghostship-security) · [Pipeline](/d/ghostship-siem-pipeline) · [AI usage](/d/ghostship-ai-usage)

**Observation only: automatic model switching and research triggers are off.** Benchmark inputs come from the Artificial Analysis free feed; unmatched models stay unknown and durable facts ingestion is disabled. Decisions and their inputs are at the top; the long usage and ranking tables are below.

panels.title: Winners by tier
panels.description: The proposed winner per provider and tier, grouped by tier so rows never interleave. Value and its source show whether the number is measured or a prior estimate; capacity is the remaining account share and expiry a duration. A free-tier value is a low-complexity choice, not frontier intelligence. Empty values are unknown, never zero.

targets.expr: max by (tier, provider, model, source) (ghostship_ai_model_winner * on(provider, model) group_left(source) ghostship_ai_model_value)
max by (tier, provider, model) (ghostship_ai_model_winner * on(provider, model) group_left() ghostship_ai_model_quality)
max by (tier, provider, model) (ghostship_ai_model_winner * on(provider, model) group_left() ghostship_ai_model_capacity_remaining)
max by (tier, provider, model) (ghostship_ai_model_winner * on(provider, model) group_left() ghostship_ai_model_capacity_expires_in_seconds)

panels.title: Candidates considered

targets.expr: max by (provider, model, source) (ghostship_ai_model_available and on(provider, model) max by (provider, model, source) (ghostship_ai_model_value{provider=~"$provider"}))

panels.description: Compared candidates for the selected providers, ordered by value. Strength and its source distinguish measurements from priors. Available is the observed availability flag; cost per task is a benchmark task price in USD, not quota capacity or a token price. Missing values stay unknown. Catalog coverage is reported separately.

panels.title: Compared vs catalog
panels.description: Compared candidates in the decision set versus models the provider catalogs list as available. The difference is catalog coverage, not an uncompared winner: only the compared set is ranked.

panels.title: How a winner is calculated
panels.description: Formula and component weights, with the configured scope. Gates are unavailable: the producer publishes only the rule body and no gate series, so no gate rows are shown and none are implied. Missing benchmark components are omitted and known weights are renormalized.

panels.title: Facts and their coverage
panels.description: Facts ingestion is disabled during owner review. Empty rows mean facts unavailable; Artificial Analysis feed inputs remain visible in Candidates considered. Automatic routing and research are off.

panels.title: Providers with no fresh reading

targets.expr: max by (provider, source) (ghostship_ai_provider_coverage unless on(source) (ghostship_ai_source_status{status="ok"} and on(source) (ghostship_ai_source_success == 1) and on(source) ((time() - ghostship_ai_source_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 900)))

max by (provider, source, status) ((ghostship_ai_provider_coverage * on(source) group_left(status) ghostship_ai_source_status) and on(source) (max by (provider, source) (ghostship_ai_provider_coverage unless on(source) (ghostship_ai_source_status{status="ok"} and on(source) (ghostship_ai_source_success == 1) and on(source) ((time() - ghostship_ai_source_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 900)))))

max by (provider, source) ((time() - ghostship_ai_source_last_success_timestamp_seconds) and on(source) (max by (provider, source) (ghostship_ai_provider_coverage unless on(source) (ghostship_ai_source_status{status="ok"} and on(source) (ghostship_ai_source_success == 1) and on(source) ((time() - ghostship_ai_source_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 900)))))

max by (provider, source) ((time() - ghostship_ai_source_observed_timestamp_seconds) and on(source) (max by (provider, source) (ghostship_ai_provider_coverage unless on(source) (ghostship_ai_source_status{status="ok"} and on(source) (ghostship_ai_source_success == 1) and on(source) ((time() - ghostship_ai_source_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 900)))))

panels.description: Exception table. A row appears only when the provider's source is not ok, is not successful, has no success within the last 15 minutes, or has no source reading at all. An empty table means every source is ok, successful and fresh; it never lists a healthy provider. Missing values stay blank instead of becoming zero.

panels.title: Routing off or disabled providers
panels.description: Providers whose routing is disabled, and the review-mode state of automatic selection. A provider listed here is never a candidate; an empty table means every configured provider is enabled.

targets.expr: ghostship_ai_source_success * on(source) group_left(status) topk by (source) (1, ghostship_ai_source_status)
sort_desc(max by (provider, account, model, window, quota, source) (100 * ghostship_ai_quota_used_ratio))

sort_desc(max by (provider, model, window, source, basis) (ghostship_ai_usage_cost_usd))
